lines: the ruin has its walls. that is about all it has.
brown sky now. by evening, grey.
you reach for a name to answer to. nothing steps forward.
rock, rock, flint. your knuckles learn it first.
cold. the first spark dies in the damp wood.
the second spark takes. you feed it the driest sticks you have.
one more look inside, you decide. then another.
behind you, your fire is down to a red thread. the cold has found your back.
